```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# Pipeline

```{r pipeline}
# The pipeline chunk of rossmann_stages2_4.Rmd, so data, features, split and
# model settings are exactly those of Stage 2.
lines <- readLines("rossmann_stages2_4.Rmd")
start <- grep("^```\\{r pipeline", lines)[1]
end   <- start + which(grepl("^```\\s*$", lines[(start + 1):length(lines)]))[1]
eval(parse(text = lines[(start + 1):(end - 1)]), envir = globalenv())
N_REPS <- 20
```

# Draws

```{r draws}
all_stores <- unique(df$Store)
draws <- map_dfr(c(50, 200, 500, length(all_stores)), function(N) {
  reps <- if (N == length(all_stores)) 1 else N_REPS
  map_dfr(seq_len(reps), function(r) { set.seed(SEED + r)
    sub <- if (N == length(all_stores)) df else df %>% filter(Store %in% sample(all_stores, N))
    run_panel(sub, as.character(N)) %>% mutate(draw = r) }) })
draws <- draws %>% mutate(N = as.integer(Condition))
write_csv(draws, "stage2_nstores_draws.csv")
```

# Table 13

```{r summary}
draw_se <- function(x) if (length(x) > 1) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)) else NA_real_
s_mean <- draws %>% group_by(N) %>%
  summarise(across(c(Naive_RMSE, StoreDOW_RMSE, XGB_RMSE, LGBM_RMSE,
                     StoreDOW_delta, XGB_delta, LGBM_delta), mean), .groups = "drop")
s_se <- draws %>% group_by(N) %>%
  summarise(XGB_delta_se = draw_se(XGB_delta), LGBM_delta_se = draw_se(LGBM_delta),
            reps = n(), .groups = "drop")
stage2_n <- left_join(s_mean, s_se, by = "N") %>% arrange(N) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~round(.x, 2)))
stage2_n
write_csv(stage2_n, "stage2_nstores.csv")
```

# Tests of Prediction 1

Within a draw the store samples are nested (same seed for every size), so the
tests pair by draw. They are in `rossmann_stage2_nstores_tests.R`, which reads
`stage2_nstores_draws.csv` and writes `stage2_nstores_tests.csv`.

```{r tests}
source("rossmann_stage2_nstores_tests.R")
```
